main_body: grass ground terrain with small flowers
evidence: This is a flat ground terrain patch (2x1 tiles of grass with tiny flowers), which properly covers rows 0-15 as a horizontal ground plane.

style.evidence: The grass uses 4 shades of green and adds small 4-pixel cross flowers, but compared to the Beodeul grass reference on the left, the base green has several large flat patches (e.g., rows 9-15 around columns 4-18) with sparser and more blocky 1px/2px noise rather than cohesive grass blade/tuft clusters.
